extracted.intended_audience: Grants.gov applicants and workspace participants (Workspace Managers and AORs)
extracted.subtask_description: Step‑by‑step operational guidance for managing a Grants.gov Workspace: accessing the Manage Workspace page, understanding the workspace progress states, preparing forms, verifying SAM registration, editing the Application Filing Name, and notifying/submitting to an agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to access the Manage Workspace page
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to navigate to the Manage Workspace page from the Applicant Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click the Manage Workspaces link on the Applicant Center page. Click the Manage link in the Actions column (on the Manage Workspaces page). This directs you to the Manage Workspace page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workspace Progress Bar: purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The Workspace progress bar displays the state of your application process within a workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the progress bar to track which submission steps are completed, in progress, or pending and to understand what remains to be done.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workspace Progress Bar: state key (icons and meanings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpretation of the progress bar icons and colors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Green with Checkmark in Circle: Completed that step. Blue with Empty Circle: Future step that is not yet completed (previous steps must first be completed to perform this step). Red with Ellipsis: Currently in progress but not yet completed. Red with 'X' in Circle: Application rejected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step — Created
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The act of creating a workspace to apply with. If you can see the progress bar, this step will be complete. For more information, review the Create a Workspace help article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step — Fill Out Forms / Forms Passed
rubrics_metrics.description: Filling out required webforms and PDF forms is a distinct step that must be completed before submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This step will take the longest amount of time. Once all the forms are filled out and the Form Status column says 'Passed' for all forms, this step will be complete. For more information, review the Forms Tab help article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step — Complete and Notify AOR / Completed and Notified AOR
rubrics_metrics.description: After forms pass, notify the user(s) with the AOR role that the workspace is ready to submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once the forms are passed, you are ready to notify the user(s) with the AOR role that the workspace is ready to submit. This state will not appear for a workspace created by an individual applicant. For more information, review the Complete Application and Notify AOR help article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step — Submit / Rejected / Submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission action and how the progress state reflects submission outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The act of submitting the grant application through Grants.gov and to the federal grant-making agency. Once the Submit button is clicked, the step name will update depending on the result. For more information, review the Submit a Workspace help article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step — Agency Received
rubrics_metrics.description: Final progress state indicating agency acknowledgement of receipt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once the workspace is submitted and the federal grant-making agency has acknowledged the successful retrieval of the application, then this step will be complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAM registration requirement and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: SAM status must be active to submit a grant application and the Manage Workspace page shows SAM Expiration Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the SAM Expiration Date is in the past or is 'Deactivated,' the Verify button will appear. Click Verify to check the SAM database. If stored SAM Expiration Date is in the past, you will receive the error message: 'SAM Registration is expired. Visit www.SAM.gov to renew prior to submission.' Go to the SAM website to renew your organization's SAM status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Filing Name: required field and editing
rubrics_metrics.description: The Application Filing Name is required for creating a workspace and can be edited after creation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access the Manage Workspace page. Click the Edit Name link next to the Application Filing Name field to open the Edit Name pop-up window. Change the Application Filing Name field to the new name and click Save. Note: This is a required field for creating a workspace. The maximum length is 240 characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom roles vs core roles guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for organizations using custom roles instead of Grants.gov core roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your organization uses custom roles rather than the core roles in Grants.gov, refer to your internal training resources about Grants.gov. The Grants.gov Online User Guide uses the core roles (i.e., Workspace Manager, Standard AOR, and Expanded AOR) to explain which users may access and perform actions. For more information, review the Manage Organization Roles help article.
